title: Savory German Sausage and Potato Fritters
description: A hearty German dish perfect for snacking or as a side. These fritters are packed with flavor and can be served with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, chopped onion, flour, italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and grated cheese. Add this mixture to the potato mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add a few patties to the skillet and fry until golden brown on both sides.
Repeat with the remaining patties, adjusting the heat as needed to prevent burning.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
